NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable Natural Roll
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Intercept rolls and hold them on the canvas. Drag and flick to roll.
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.EnableTimeout.Name: Enable Auto-Roll Timeout
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.EnableTimeout.Hint: Automatically roll the dice if they are not picked up after a certain amount of time.
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.TimeoutDuration.Hi: Number of seconds to wait before auto-rolling if the dice are not picked up.
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.GrabRadius.Name: Grab Radius (Pixels)
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.GrabRadius.Hint: Minimum pixel distance from a die required to grab/pick it up.
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.SpawnAtCursor.Name: Spawn Dice at Cursor
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.SpawnAtCursor.Hint: Spawn the dice directly under your mouse/pointer instead of the center of the screen.
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.EnableRattleSfx.Hi: Play rattling/collision sound effects when shaking the dice in your hand.
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.DiceSpread.Name: Dice Spread / Spacing
NATURAL_ROLL.Settings.DiceSpread.Hint: Adjust the spacing/spread scale of the initial dice pool (default is 0.06).
NATURAL_ROLL.Warnings.DsnRequired: Natural Roll requires the 'Dice So Nice!' module to be installed and active.
